correctness.rationale: For every admissible signature, \(K=-\frac14\log(F_L/L^3)\) with positive integer \(F_L=(L-2t-v)^2(L-2v)\). Exhaustive integer comparison gives no strict reversal for \(L\le8\), exactly one at \(L=9\), and exact explicit sequence realization of the witness.

value.rationale: DNA barcoding and related specimen-identification workflows use sequence distances for nearest-neighbor decisions, while p-distance and K2P treat transition/transversion composition differently. The sharp nine-site boundary gives the smallest exact instance where that modeling distinction alone can change the selected neighbor and explains the mechanism through a simple integer invariant.
